svg.text: StackChan, platform B: a robot that learns from its own life (mode life)
M5Stack CoreS3 / ESP32-S3, 20 Hz brain tick (50 ms) - fast loop on the robot, slow loop (the night sleep) on the home PC - safety stays deterministic C++
dashed = feedback / efference | numbers: params, MACs, measured time on the robot
3 channels: lum, compensated diff, raw diff
exact: brightness, light change, bright spot
touch 150 ms; shake held 2 s; tilt 1.5 s
time of day: night, day, dawn, dusk windows
+ dense 64 -> 13 outputs; 24 k params, 0.57 M MAC
sim + COCO + this camera; NIGHTLY: its own frames
labelled by YOLOv8n + YuNet on the PC; ~26 ms
NIGHTLY: its own sound, labelled by
Silero VAD + PANNs CNN14 on the PC
classes: silence speech clap sharp cont. low high tonal
Kept from v3 (mode brain, the way back)
In mode life both are off: the SNN state
section of the bus is zero (CPU 52 -> 36 %)
World model GRU (predicts the next tick)
-> 48 -> 49 predicted changes of vision, hearing, body
RMS error per group + learning progress -> diary
retrained every night from the whole diary (gate: skill)
energy, social, stimulation, rest, comfort (0..1, grow by themselves)
reward = sum w (D(t-1) - D(t)) - 0.0002 / deg, D = d^2 (Keramati-Gutkin)
CURIOSITY: world-model error well above its habitual level (60 s)
eases the stimulation need; own voice / motion are not new
needs kept in NVS over a reboot
cue cells -> petting / rough handling / being talked to
state 71 (senses, needs, world errors, expectations) -> 64 -> GRU 64 -> 48 -> 24
move? where (Gaussian yaw / pitch), speed, call?, face (12), voice style (4), value
night: advantage-weighted regression on the diary (critic on the PC)
day: plastic dW 8 x 48 on its hidden layer, TD(lambda) actor-critic,
delta = r + gamma V(t) - V(t-1): the dopamine; by day only; |dW| <= 1
gate: 2-8 moves and 0.3-8 calls a minute
Collector: samples the decisions, keeps the rules
every touch answered (a rule: masked in the actor's training)
faces, voice colour, LEDs; motor babbling when no actor
head: joint windows, steps <= 30 deg, speed by stamina, 10 servo packets/s
voice <= half of the last minute (mode life)
face of 21 (debounced), gaze, blink; LEDs: breathing + heartbeat
servo stall (gyro) -> rail power cycle, back-off 1-60 min; panel recover
touch storm filter, stuck pad re-setup, task WDT, battery
OTA: A/B firmware with rollback; weights blob, NaN -> restart
Droid voice: BabbleNet GRU + analogue synth (own task)
a phrase note by note: 10 kinds of droid sounds, glide, ending, pitch,
FM, harmonics; the shown face picks the character; no speech model
body feedback: real head velocity (gyro), servo state, battery, own voice
The home PC: the slow loop (nothing leaves the home network)
